entities.name: Jesuit Church, Bratislava

entities.summary: The Holy Saviour Church (Slovak: Kostol Najsvätejšieho Spasiteľa, also called Jezuitský kostol,m or the Jesuit Church, is a church building constructed in the 17th century on Františkánske nám in the Old Town of Bratislava, Slovakia. It was originally built to serve as a protestant house of worship. Today the church belongs to the Society of Jesus, known as the Jesuit Order.
